organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Government
organizations.description:
Consolidated local government serving Macon-Bibb County, Georgia. The mayor leads the executive branch; a mayor and nine commissioners constitute the legislative commission.

Source: https://www.maconbibb.us/

organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Board of Commissioners
organizations.description:
Legislative governing body consisting of the mayor and nine district commissioners. Commissioners are elected to four-year terms.

Source: https://www.maconbibb.us/commissioners/

organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Manager’s Office
organizations.description:

Source: https://www.maconbibb.us/county-manager/

organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Land Bank Authority
organizations.description:
Governmental authority established in 1996 through an intergovernmental agreement. Acquires and returns tax-delinquent, vacant and blighted properties to productive use. Its official board roster lists five members.

Source: https://maconlandbank.org/our-purpose/
organizations.notes: Appointment mechanism and individual appointment dates need enabling-agreement review.

organizations.name: Macon Water Authority
organizations.description:
Public water, sewer and stormwater authority. Seven-member board: four district representatives and a countywide chair elected by voters, plus two mayoral appointees. The board directly supervises the President and Executive Director.

Source: https://maconwater.org/your-mwa/board-members/

organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Transit Authority
organizations.description:

Source: https://mbcta.net/board/
organizations.notes: Only six board members published; seventh seat unresolved. CEO is not classified as a board member.

organizations.name: Macon-Bibb County Urban Development Authority
organizations.description:

Source: https://maconbibbuda.com/your-uda/
organizations.notes: Roster page labels Jonathan Barton Vice Chair, while Jan Beeland biography also says vice chair; officer ambiguity is unresolved.

organizations.name: Downtown Macon Parking Advisory Board
organizations.description:
Seven-member advisory board appointed by the Urban Development Authority. Advises on paid on-street and off-street parking, garages, special parking policies and strategic plans. Seats represent the UDA, a business owner, an employee, a downtown resident, the disabled community and two at-large residents.

Source: https://www.parkmacon.com/public-engagement

organizations.name: Middle Georgia Regional Commission
organizations.address_line: 3661 Eisenhower Parkway, Suite MB102, Macon, GA 31206
organizations.description:
Regional governmental planning and service agency serving eleven Middle Georgia counties, including Macon-Bibb. Its services include planning and public administration, economic development and lending, technology, transportation and transit, and the Area Agency on Aging. The governing council establishes policy and, through its Budget, Audit and Personnel Committee, hires the executive director; the executive director hires staff.

The 2026–27 officer list identifies Jenna S. Mashburn as chair, Denese Shinholster as vice chair, Kerry Dunaway as secretary and Executive Director Laura M. Mathis as ex-officio treasurer. Macon-Bibb representatives listed on the council roster are Lester Miller, Valerie Wynn, Carlos McCloud, Wallace Herring and Michelle Parks.

Sources: https://www.middlegeorgiarc.org/about-us/mission-values/ ; https://www.middlegeorgiarc.org/mgrc-council-2/ ; https://www.middlegeorgiarc.org/mgrc-council-2/officers-and-committees/ ; https://www.middlegeorgiarc.org/about-us/staff/
organizations.notes: The leadership page states a 60-member council; the council directory lists 59 named members. Only named members are imported. The general council page labels Denese Shinholster as treasurer; the dated 2026–27 officers page identifies her as vice chair and Laura Mathis as ex-officio treasurer. The dated officer list is used. Roster spellings and council seat categories are preserved. Individual appointment dates and service terms are not inferred. The Aging Advisory Council page says appointments are not yet made; the Ethics Committee has no named appointees. No members were invented. Only senior management, department directors and the executive assistant are included from the staff directory.
